B0.note: Runs the CNN14 architecture with random initialization unless an external PANNs checkpoint is supplied.

B1.note: Runs the HTSAT-tiny architecture with random initialization unless an external Hugging Face checkpoint is supplied.

B5_shuffle_control.note: Permute Leq metadata while leaving audio, class labels, and split membership unchanged.

B7_shuffle_control.note: Control that breaks alignment between audio content and Leq condition.

E1.question: LAeq-only classification baseline
E1.feature: one continuous LAeq value in dB
E1.selection: fit on training rows; select by validation Macro-F1, then accuracy; logistic ties use smaller C; tree ties use shallower depth then larger min_samples_leaf; evaluate frozen test splits once
E1.scaling: fit StandardScaler on training rows only for logistic regression

E2.question: Does continuous LAeq add information to frozen audio embeddings?
E2.selection: fit separate audio-only and numeric-fusion heads per seed; fit scaling on training rows only; select C by validation Macro-F1, then accuracy, then smaller C; evaluate frozen test splits once
E2.primary_contrast: paired numeric-fusion minus audio-only metrics on the same checkpoint seed and sample windows
